items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: They had planned to get rid of Harry and get Dizzy Gillespie, because they went to school together. ... They was going to have a clique got formed to get Charlie Shavers and who else, in that band? Charlie Shavers and somebody.

ctx.x: Berth, and you pull a curtain, and you sleep in there. The Pullman porter makes the bed for you. If you’re fat, they have to get a ladder for you to get up in an upper berth, so Chu Berry, they put him down on the floor, because he’s fat. I’m a newcomer. I’m due to have the third berth from the door, because that boy, that seniority, and it was . . . I’m supposed to take his place, but by hook or crook they didn’t. They put me . . . you know. Chicanery. Underhand [expletive deleted]. They put me way in the back,…
Was Jonah Jones in that band?

items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Reminds me some of Charlie Shavers. He was called 'The Diminished King.'

ctx.x: Yeah. They played the polite music, and played for all the people, all the White folks, they'd play all the colleges in Mississippi and around here -- and they was the top band...reading band.

But then they had the funky bands that played for the people, like Buddy Petit and Kid Rena. Buddy Petit was a fantastic musician. Reminds me some of Charlie Shavers. He was called "The Diminished King." Louis got all them diminished things, that's what everybody said, from Buddy. Because Buddy was older than Louis. Buddy was the boss after King Oliver. See, Bunk disappeared, so it left the mantle to King Oliver...
